name: Mixed-media paper
description: Layered scraps, tape and contrasting paper textures.

instructions.image: Coherent mixed-media world of photographic cutouts, ink details, patterned paper, cardboard, tape and magazine scraps; real product remains an accurate photo cutout.
instructions.motion: Rigid pieces slide and pivot in depth; parallax; assemble or peel between ideas.
instructions.composition: Keep all titles, labels, data and logos as editable HTML/SVG overlays. Use approved copy and supplied screenshots. Brand colors and fonts override reference palettes. Keep one style for the whole film.
instructions.negative: No generated text, logos, invented statistics or fake product UI. No unseeded randomness, render-time network or live clocks.
requiredAssets: One approved style key reused for every shot
acceptance: Style remains visible in hook, screenshot, success and CTA beats
Readable copy in landscape, portrait and square
Identical pixels after repeated and backward seeking
All visual marks follow the selected brand/theme
Generated material reference is distinct from the shipped graphic adaptation
